sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS patient_id
FROM mamba_flat_encounter_art_card_1 a
JOIN mamba_flat_encounter_art_summary_card s
    ON s.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE s.hiv_enrollment_date <= :endDate
  AND DATE(a.encounter_datetime) BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND (
      s.transfer_out_date IS NULL
      OR s.transfer_out_date > :endDate
  )
  AND (
      s.date_lost_to_followup IS NULL
      OR s.date_lost_to_followup > :endDate
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_flat_encounter_art_card_1 art
      WHERE art.client_id = a.client_id
        AND art.historical_drug_start_date IS NOT NULL
        AND art.historical_drug_start_date <= :endDate
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_regimen_change r
      WHERE r.client_id = a.client_id
        AND r.encounter_date <= :endDate
  );
